headline: Voters reject data center measures across 2026 US midterm ballots
summary: Data centers fared badly in the 2026 US midterms, with Tom's Hardware reporting that 45 ballot measures across several counties saw most Americans vote against development, and Engadget saying the rebuke was strongest in now-blue Ohio. Wired reports data centers and their supporters struggled from high-profile Senate races to local rezoning initiatives.

claims.statement: Voters across the US overwhelmingly rejected data center-related ballot measures in the 2026 midterms.
